[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]So much has changed...[XENO:n ]
It's only been a month.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT19 ]We'll find Juujuu and then smash some metal![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]Wait! We can't just rush in.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]We could enter through the mine.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
There's a massive ether deposit under the colony.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

The first settlers here built right on top of[XENO:n ]
the mine. That's how we got our colony.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

The mine is like a network of tunnels. It's much[XENO:n ]
more complicated than the colony streets.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

They can't have figured it all out[XENO:n ]
in the space of a month.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]She means it's the best route[XENO:n ]
if we want to remain unseen.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
So how do we get in?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT22 ][XENO:del del=this ]

Through the Drainage Outlet.[XENO:n ]
It's just up ahead.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
